title: Hold the Keep Gate
summary: Osric Hale held a gate once, for longer than anyone asked him to. He'd like to see a fighter of yours do the same, in Wickham Keep, and then he'll show them how to stand behind a shield.

steps.journal: Hold eight waves in Wickham Keep. Any rooms; stand your ground in them.

ready: Go back to Osric Hale in Thornwick.
done: Osric showed your fighters Shield Wall: plant your feet, lift the shield, and let them come to you.
